gaps.valueSet: Source branches marked not implemented because no codes are available
gaps.reason: the unavailable branches include Soft Tick Relapsing Fever ICD10CM, Hard Tick Relapsing Fever ICD10CM, the STRF-group nucleic-acid test, the Borrelia miyamotoi culture test, and several specimen-specific spirochete microscopy tests; coded alternatives are retained where the source provides them
SEM_V1 has no laboratory specimen-type predicate; the curated rules retain source-authorized blood, bone-marrow, and cerebrospinal-fluid test-name alternatives that do not require specimen matching

both source rules require an epidemiologic exposure within 21 days of illness onset, which the source marks not implemented and SEM_V1 cannot represent; the rules are omitted rather than allowing clinical findings alone to report
the source identifies death-certificate evidence, but SEM_V1 has no death-certificate evidence
